# Heeey (heeey.click)

Heeey is a collaborative whiteboard and diagramming web application built on top of the official Excalidraw open-source editor core (`@excalidraw/excalidraw` 0.18.x), featuring cloud persistence, real-time multiplayer via Supabase (Broadcast and Presence), hybrid guest/magic-link authentication, multi-board dashboard with folders, soft-delete trash, version history, full-text canvas search, personal libraries, public REST API, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents.

## What We Are

- Web application: https://heeey.click
- Open-source repository: https://github.com/carloseorsantos/heeey.click
- Documentation: https://heeey.click/docs (in Portuguese, English and Spanish; it follows the app's language, or pass `?lang=en-US`, `?lang=es-ES` or `?lang=pt-BR`)
- Website languages: Portuguese https://heeey.click/, English https://heeey.click/en, Spanish https://heeey.click/es
- Localized versions of this file: https://heeey.click/pt-br/llms.txt (Portuguese), https://heeey.click/es/llms.txt (Spanish)
- Core Whiteboard engine: `@excalidraw/excalidraw` 0.18.x

## What We Do

- Real-time collaborative whiteboarding and diagramming with hand-drawn vector aesthetics.
- Multiplayer synchronization with live cursors, participant colors, and laser pointer via Supabase Realtime (`heeey:room:{boardId}`).
- Multi-board dashboard with hierarchical folders, breadcrumbs, search, and soft-delete trash.
- Automated point-in-time version history (snapshots every 10 min and pre-restore snapshots) with conflict-free restore bumping and 30-day snapshot retention.
- Complete internationalization (i18n) supporting Portuguese (`pt-BR`), English (`en-US`) and Spanish (`es-ES`) across the app, the website pages and the docs, with browser language detection and Excalidraw locale synchronization.
- Personal component libraries with cloud sync for authenticated users and local migration for guests.
- Automated client-side image compression (WebP, max 1600px, <150KB) and Supabase Storage integration (`board-media`).
- Full-text search across board titles and canvas text (labels and shapes) with unaccent and contextual snippet preview.
- Public REST API (`/api/v1`) with personal API keys (`hk_...`), read/write scopes, and shorthand element specs.
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (`/api/mcp`) via Streamable HTTP for AI agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor).
- Automated diagram layout engine using Dagre/Sugiyama algorithm (`create_diagram`, `layout_board`) with automatic node sizing, smart arrow routing, and flow directions (`TB`, `LR`, `BT`, `RL`).

## Integration Facts

- Public REST API base URL: https://heeey.click/api/v1
- MCP endpoint: https://heeey.click/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0)
- MCP Protocol versions: 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05
- Authentication header: `Authorization: Bearer hk_...` or `X-API-Key: hk_...`
- API and MCP are currently in active production beta.
